@group A 文意字彙（1–5）：依提示寫出正確的字

Q 1 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: This p______e is the most famous tourist attraction in this city. It is a beautiful building surrounded by a big garden.
= palace
~詞義 palace（n.）宮殿
~原文 This palace is the most famous tourist attraction in this city. It is a beautiful building surrounded by a big garden.

Q 2 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Tony tried to stay serious during the speech but burst into l______r when his friend made a funny face.
= laughter
~詞義 laughter（n.）笑(聲)
~原文 Tony tried to stay serious during the speech but burst into laughter when his friend made a funny face.

Q 3 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Greta p______ked when she realized her passport was missing just minutes before boarding the plane.
= panicked
~詞義 panic（v.）驚慌失措
~原文 Greta panicked when she realized her passport was missing just minutes before boarding the plane.

Q 4 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: You should help others for the s______e of being helpful, not just to make yourself look good.
= sake
~詞義 sake（n.）緣故
~原文 You should help others for the sake of being helpful, not just to make yourself look good.

Q 5 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The plane that carried the passengers across the Pacific was a wide-bodied j______t.
= jet
~詞義 jet（n.）噴射機
~原文 The plane that carried the passengers across the Pacific was a wide-bodied jet.

@group B 選擇題（6–10）

Q 6 | choice | 選擇題
stem: What you just did was a genuinely kind ______. I am very proud of you.
A: deed
B: kidney
C: jelly
D: scout
= A
~詞義 deed（n.）行為
~原文 What you just did was a genuinely kind deed. I am very proud of you.

Q 7 | choice | 選擇題
stem: One benefit of Jacob's weight loss is that he feels more ______ and healthy.
A: inferior
B: frightening
C: energetic
D: terrifying
= C
~詞義 energetic（adj.）充滿活力的
~原文 One benefit of Jacob's weight loss is that he feels more energetic and healthy.

Q 8 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Jessica often hangs out with her friends at the ______. They like to go shopping and have afternoon tea together.
A: disc
B: screw
C: fairy
D: mall
= D
~詞義 mall（n.）購物中心
~原文 Jessica often hangs out with her friends at the mall. They like to go shopping and have afternoon tea together.

Q 9 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Great inventions like electricity and the Internet have completely changed the way ______ lives and communicates.
A: conduct
B: handful
C: necktie
D: mankind
= D
~詞義 mankind（n.）人類
~原文 Great inventions like electricity and the Internet have completely changed the way mankind lives and communicates.

Q 10 | choice | 選擇題
stem: This ______ features a good public school, a bookstore, and a beautiful park. Therefore, many people want to live here.
A: gasoline
B: industry
C: neighborhood
D: keyboard
= C
~詞義 neighborhood（n.）街區
~原文 This neighborhood features a good public school, a bookstore, and a beautiful park. Therefore, many people want to live here.

@group C 配合題（11–15）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: inferior
B: screws
C: industrial
D: drips
E: fairly
F: deck

Q 11 | bank | 配合題
stem: Jack waved farewell to his family and friends from the ______ as the ship sailed away.
= F
~詞義 deck（n.）甲板
~原文 Jack waved farewell to his family and friends from the deck as the ship sailed away.

Q 12 | bank | 配合題
stem: Despite his wealth, Don lives in a(n) ______ modest house that contains only a few pieces of furniture.
= E
~詞義 fairly（adv.）相當地
~原文 Despite his wealth, Don lives in a(n) fairly modest house that contains only a few pieces of furniture.

Q 13 | bank | 配合題
stem: The boy always feels that he is ______ to other people because he is short.
= A
~詞義 inferior（adj.）較差的
~原文 The boy always feels that he is inferior to other people because he is short.

Q 14 | bank | 配合題
stem: A meeting of the leaders of the world's major ______ nations was held to discuss the issue of global warming.
= C
~詞義 industrial（adj.）工業的
~原文 A meeting of the leaders of the world's major industrial nations was held to discuss the issue of global warming.

Q 15 | bank | 配合題
stem: The ______ holding the bed together have loosened, so we need to tighten them.
= B
~詞義 screw（n.）螺絲
~原文 The screws holding the bed together have loosened, so we need to tighten them.

@group C 配合題（16–20）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: fairy
B: handy
C: industry
D: scary
E: pancakes
F: queer

Q 16 | bank | 配合題
stem: My father works in the automobile ______, so he knows a lot about the quality and prices of various cars.
= C
~詞義 industry（n.）產業
~原文 My father works in the automobile industry, so he knows a lot about the quality and prices of various cars.

Q 17 | bank | 配合題
stem: There was something ______ about the atmosphere in the room, as if something strange had just happened there.
= F
~詞義 queer（adj.）奇怪的
~原文 There was something queer about the atmosphere in the room, as if something strange had just happened there.

Q 18 | bank | 配合題
stem: I wonder why witches in ______ tales are always evil.
= A
~詞義 fairy（n.）小仙子
~原文 I wonder why witches in fairy tales are always evil.

Q 19 | bank | 配合題
stem: The ghost in the movie looked really ______ and gave me a nightmare last night.
= D
~詞義 scary（adj.）可怕的
~原文 The ghost in the movie looked really scary and gave me a nightmare last night.

Q 20 | bank | 配合題
stem: When I get up early, I always have ______ for breakfast.
= E
~詞義 pancake（n.）鬆餅
~原文 When I get up early, I always have pancakes for breakfast.
